story.title: Where Indonesian Heritage Weaving Meets Haute Leather Artistry.
story.body: Founded by Titik Kurniasih in BSD City, Tangerang Selatan, Ninauka elevates authentic Indonesian raw materials into world-class luxury artisan handbags, evening clutches, and bespoke accessories. Combining certified genuine python skin, vegetable-tanned cowhide, traditional handwoven Tenun Baduy from Banten, and indigenous Doyo leaf fiber weaving from East Kalimantan, each creation embodies sustainable craftsmanship and ancestral culture. From exclusive Python Kelly and Minaudière bags to eco-conscious Indonesian goni (burlap) totes, Ninauka creates collector-grade pieces tailored for international exhibitions, luxury gifting, and global discerning buyers.

highlights.title: Excellence Python Skin Collection
highlights.body: Signature handcrafted Kelly Bags (KE.01, KC.02), Minaudière Evening Clutches (MA.03, MA.05), Multi-Clutches (MCB.02), and Limas Bags (LP1) tailored with flawless genuine python hide and premium hardware.

highlights.title: East Kalimantan Doyo Ulap Weaving
highlights.body: Eco-friendly handwoven textile made from wild Doyo leaf fiber (Curculigo latifolia) by Dayak Benuag artisans, naturally dyed with wood and tree bark, combined with python and cow leather.

highlights.title: Tenun Baduy Handcrafted Line
highlights.body: Traditional handspun cotton woven by Baduy women in Lebak Banten using ancestral gedogan wooden looms and safe eco-friendly dyes, celebrating authentic tribal silhouettes.

highlights.title: Indonesian Goni (Burlap) & Bespoke Hampers
highlights.body: Eco-luxury tote bags and clutches combining natural Indonesian jute/burlap with cow leather accents (GA1, GA2, GA3), packaged in luxury exclusive gift boxes for corporate and VIP gifting.
